lines.text: the parallel postulate was assumed for two thousand years
Three line modules arranged in parallel to visualize equidistant lines
the angle sum of a triangle is not a fact about triangles but a fact about the space they …
lines.note: the triangle cannot supply its own angle sum — 180° is a fact about the space, and the space arrives as a postulate every proof uses and no proof produces: certainty standing on a decision, not a truth.

lines.text: flat space is not the default — it is the singular boundary between two infinite families of …
on a positively curved surface, there is no room for parallel lines
infinity can be contained in a finite disk — the Poincare model proves that hyperbolic geometry is as consistent as …
lines.note: hyperbolic space cannot be drawn honestly: the disk buys a finite picture of infinity by crushing the metric toward the rim, so every equal step outward is drawn smaller and the boundary is infinity rendered as a wall.

lines.text: on a negatively curved surface, there are infinitely many parallel lines through any point
infinity is not the absence of a boundary — it is a boundary that has been folded back into the space it …
The set that contains itself, all the way down - R = {x : x not-in x}, is R in R?
lines.note: a set that contains itself cannot supply its own bottom: the nest is only legible because someone cut it at five, and that cut — foundation, types, a levels export — is the restriction the paradox extorted.

lines.text: Russell's Paradox: the barber who shaves all who don't shave themselves - does he shave himself? The rule eats …
naive set theory is inconsistent — the set of all sets that do not contain themselves destroyed the foundations of mathematics in …
The liar paradox: THIS STATEMENT IS FALSE - a truth value that oscillates forever
if G were provable it would be false (it asserts its own unprovability)
lines.note: the machine builds G out of its own rules but cannot supply the standpoint from which G reads true — the gold verdict is spoken from outside, on a soundness no arm inside can reach.

lines.text: The provable is a proper subset of the true - statements fall into the gap that never …
Add an axiom to close the gap and a new gap opens above - incompleteness all the way up
locally coherent does not mean globally possible
lines.note: an impossible figure cannot supply its own coherence: it depends on the one standpoint where the loop appears to close, and pays by hiding the joint — the fourth side quietly eased to zero where nobody looks.

lines.text: representation is a gap pretending to be a bridge -- computation runs on signs detached from …
each corner is valid, the object is not -- incompleteness you can hold in your hands
The blivet: two prongs become three - consistent locally, impossible globally
existence without construction is an article of faith, not a proof
lines.note: existence here cannot be asserted, only produced: the proof depends on somebody building the witness in time, and pays in everything true but unbuilt — the platforms that trail off are not false, they are unconstructed.

lines.text: an infinite object that is never finished is not incomplete
Brouwer's intuitionism: the next step isn't true-or-false until you construct it
the law of excluded middle is not a law of logic

pearls.edge: no test inside the chamber tells the two ghosts apart, so undecidability only becomes legible on a screen bolted to the wall: the lesson needs the outside view the fight forbids, or it reads as bad aim.

lines.text: observation does not reveal a pre-existing state — it creates one
lines.note: the box cannot show what it holds — superposition needs the lid shut — so its only freedom is where to put the part it cannot display: sealed in the core, split to a twin, smeared into haze.

lines.text: Florensky's paraconsistency: open AND closed, P and not-P, and the world does not end
A and not-A can both be true. This is not a failure of logic but a description of reality that classical logic cannot contain
superposition is not uncertainty about which state the system is in
lambda is the entropy drive — the dial between crystallization and dissolution that every living system must …
lines.note: the dial depends on a calibration chain that ends nowhere — there is no metre bar for how much a system should value disorder — so the instrument covers the gap by painting the right answer on in green.

lines.text: phi is the queer parameter — positive phi means the system does not merely tolerate change but seeks it as …
the edge of chaos is not a metaphor — it is a precise mathematical boundary where computation is …
the formula is not an equation to solve but a lens to see every system through
